voices.note: anonymous Gemara voice: every question and answer of 9a.2-13
Rav Sheshet's law is said משום רבי עקיבא (9a.3)
cited at 9a.8: אין עושין סוכה בחולו של מועד
transmits Rav's tzitzit ruling and Shmuel's reply (9a.9-10)

props.gloss_en: an old sukkah -- Beit Shammai invalidate it
Beit Shammai's reason is the verse 'the festival of Sukkot, seven days, to the Lord'
we require a sukkah made for the sake of the festival (Beit Shammai, as the stam gives it; restated at 9a.6)
for Beit Hillel, that verse is needed for Rav Sheshet's law
Rav Sheshet in R' Akiva's name: that the wood of the sukkah is forbidden all seven days is derived from 'the festival of Sukkot, seven days, to the Lord'

R' Yehuda ben Beteira: as the name of Heaven takes effect on the festival offering, so it takes effect on the sukkah -- 'the festival ... to the Lord': as the festival [offering] is to the Lord, so the sukkah is to the Lord
rather, Beit Shammai's reason is another verse: 'the festival of Sukkot you shall make for yourself, seven days'
for Beit Hillel, that verse is needed [to teach] that one may build a sukkah on chol hamoed
Beit Shammai hold like R' Eliezer [and so the verse is free for them]
R' Eliezer: one does not build a sukkah on chol hamoed
Rav: [tzitzit] made from kotzin, nimin or gradin are invalid
Shmuel (to Rav Yehuda): even from sisin -- invalid
evidently [tzitzit] require spinning for their own sake
there it is different: the verse says 'fringes you shall make for yourself' -- 'for yourself': for the sake of your obligation
that [לך of the sukkah verse] is needed to exclude a stolen [sukkah]
there another verse is written, 'and they shall make for themselves' -- of their own [excluding stolen tzitzit]

schemas.gloss_en: מה חג לה' אף סוכה לה': as the name of Heaven takes effect on the festival offering, so on the sukkah (the shared לה' of 'חג הסוכות שבעת ימים לה'')

supports.gloss_en: ותניא: the name of Heaven rests on the sukkah as on the festival offering -- so its wood is forbidden all seven days (kind svara: bare ותניא; header)

objections.gloss_en: ובית הלל? -- and Beit Hillel, what of this verse [which requires a sukkah made for the festival]?

answered_by.gloss_en: ההוא מיבעי ליה לכדרב ששת -- the verse is needed for the prohibition of the sukkah's wood all seven days (= p_bh_lerav_sheshet)

objections.gloss_en: ובית שמאי נמי מיבעי ליה להכי! -- Beit Shammai too need the verse for Rav Sheshet's law. Conceded: אין הכי נמי; the stam replaces the verse at 9a.6 (retract commit)
ובית הלל? -- and Beit Hillel, what of 'the festival of Sukkot you shall make'?

answered_by.gloss_en: ההוא מיבעי ליה לעושין סוכה בחולו של מועד (= p_bh_osin_bechol_hamoed)

objections.gloss_en: ובית שמאי? -- and Beit Shammai, do they not need the verse for building on chol hamoed?

answered_by.gloss_en: סבירא להו כרבי אליעזר, דאמר: אין עושין סוכה בחולו של מועד (= p_bs_kerabbi_eliezer, p_reliezer_ein_osin)

objections.gloss_en: ובית הלל לית להו דרב יהודה אמר רב? ... אמר לי [שמואל]: אף מן הסיסין נמי פסולה, אלמא דבעינן טויה לשמה -- הכא נמי בעינן סוכה עשויה לשמה! (an amoraic-memra objection; kind svara under the §12 gap)

answered_by.gloss_en: שאני התם, דאמר קרא: גדילים תעשה לך -- לך, לשם חובך (= p_tzitzit_lach_lshem_chovach)

objections.gloss_en: הכא נמי: חג הסוכות תעשה לך -- לך, לשם חובך! (attacks the answer a_shaani_hatam: the sukkah verse also says לך, so a sukkah too should need making lishmah)

answered_by.gloss_en: ההוא מיבעי ליה למעוטי גזולה (= p_sukkah_lach_gzula)

objections.gloss_en: התם נמי מיבעי ליה למעוטי גזולה! -- the tzitzit verse's לך should likewise be spent on excluding stolen tzitzit

answered_by.gloss_en: התם כתיב קרא אחרינא: ועשו להם -- משלהם (= p_tzitzit_mishelahem)
